title: Notebook app: what goes into the settings redesign?
intro: Six choices from the redesign. My recommendation is preselected on each; change what you disagree with and press Done.
notice: Synthetic data only: the app, the screens and the numbers are made up.

items.title: Settings in two columns
items.description: The settings page is one long column today. Two columns put Account and Editor next to Sync and Notifications.
items.cost: About 60 lines of CSS, no new components.

items.title: Collapsible sidebar
items.description: An icon-only sidebar that gives the notes 160 px more width.
items.cost: About 150 lines and a new remembered setting. Needs tooltips for every icon.

items.title: Which filters on the notes list?
items.description: Filters sit as pills above the list. Each one is a query and a pill.

items.title: Illustration for an empty list
items.description: A small drawing and one line of help when a filter matches nothing.
items.cost: One SVG asset, rendered to PNG, and 20 lines.

items.title: Default theme
items.description: What a new install shows before anyone touches the setting.

items.title: Export formats
items.description: Formats offered in the Export menu.
items.cost: Markdown is free; PDF adds a print stylesheet; HTML adds a template.

free_text.title: Anything else
free_text.placeholder: Anything the list does not ask about
